</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8d62afdc-71b0-4205-adc3-588a4522015a.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="prefight"><ins><nowiki>Prefight</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Stall </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at Wars → Enter instance</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>When everyone is in: (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + r </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1" alt="adaptivestrike" title="adaptivestrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (out of range) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="naturalinstinct" title="naturalinstinct" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → s</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1" alt="varanussmercy" title="varanussmercy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Prefight notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>If team banks slow swap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="naturalinstinct" title="naturalinstinct" kind="icon" /><nowiki> but might cause </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown issues on pillars, alternatively if base starts slower you can do </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1" alt="meleebasic" title="meleebasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="naturalinstinct" title="naturalinstinct" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>If your team is struggling with dps you can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="dba" title="dba" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at wars before stalling </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at 2.4s (before you see 2 on timer)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1"><ins><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>(tc </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1" alt="ezk" title="ezk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1" alt="gfury" title="gfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1" alt="rend" title="rend" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>P1 notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>TC </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at 6 seconds on the boss timer</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>If adren is for some reason not good you can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1" alt="rend" title="rend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>If &quot;Hammer&quot; Role, swap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1" alt="varanussmercy" title="varanussmercy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>If &quot;Smoke Cloud&quot; Role, swap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1" alt="varanussmercy" title="varanussmercy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2"><ins><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrows" title="wenarrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>P2 notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Timing the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is very important on the voiceline 'Show these intruders the true meaning of pain!</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>If the boss phases on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> wait 1 tick before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, if it phased on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> no need to wait, if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213159071547395.png?v=1" alt="nex" title="nex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> phased off tick you will have to resync using smoke visuals or the voiceline</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3"><ins><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>(+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if the boss isn't phased yet)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on team or otherwise swap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" <nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timing:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Umbra ASAP, usually on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Glacies: 2 ticks after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Cruor: Same tick as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (inputs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> same tick)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Fumus: Needs to run in during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> couple ticks after it starts channeling</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="pillars"><ins><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>1st Pillar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>2nd Pillar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337470491033600.png?v=1" alt="replenpot" title="replenpot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>3rd Pillar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><strong><nowiki>4th Pillar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Assuming normal order (UGCF) you should use the following abilities to move between pillars:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to pillar 1 → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to 2 → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to 3 &amp; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to 4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ If pillar 3 damage is lacking for the team can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1" alt="varanussmercy" title="varanussmercy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pillar 4</nowiki></p>
